**Description of changes**
A clear and concise description of what this PR changes and why.

**Type of change**
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactor (code change that improves structure without changing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation (docs, comments, or README updates)

**How has this been tested?**
Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes. Include relevant commands and outputs.

**Checklist**
- [ ] Code compiles with 0 errors
- [ ] Tests pass (`cargo test --lib`)
- [ ] No new warnings (`cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`)
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated
- [ ] Documentation updated
